channelTitle: Toothache acting up? Grandma's clove oil trick
hook: Tooth throbbing and the dentist can't see you until tomorrow? Grandma always kept a little clove oil on hand.
remedy: As an old-fashioned home remedy passed down for generations, a dab of diluted clove oil on the sore spot has long been used to take the edge off a nagging toothache while you wait to see a dentist.
steps: Mix a drop or two of clove oil with a teaspoon of a carrier oil like olive oil
Dab a small amount onto a cotton ball and press it gently against the sore tooth or gum
Leave it in place for a few minutes, then rinse your mouth with warm water
caution: Never swallow clove oil, don't use it undiluted, avoid it around young children, and see a dentist for the underlying problem — this is only a temporary comfort measure.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
